questions.question: Which evidence lets another learner reproduce your environment?
options: A screenshot of the final number only
Python/package versions, device information, and the script
questions.explanation: The script records what ran; versions and device information record where it ran. CPU success is separate from TPU compatibility.
optionFeedback: A screenshot records the result, but leaves the inputs and computation hidden. Give another learner the script and environment record so they can try to reproduce it.
The script records what ran; versions and device information record where it ran. CPU success is separate from TPU compatibility.
